Proves that data richness D cannot be substituted by power P: as D → 0, the intelligence bound P·D/(k_B·T·ln 2) → 0 regardless of P. Zero sorry statements. Includes constructive ε-M proof of compensation_diverges with explicit δ witness. Part of the Viridis Applied Proofs Series, supplementing the foundational Intelligence Bound canon (10.5281/zenodo.20006414). Aristotle project ID: 2ad31dc8-a9ba-4687-a167-9660a9209d2b.
